scope: Check and prepare physically defined replacement benchmark; no converged Earth-kernel performance claim from these checks.

user_choices.matrix_backend: Eigen internal matrix multiplication; external BLAS disabled for candidate

proposed_fixture.frequency_filter: unity below8mHz; cosine transition8–10mHz; zero at/above10mHz
proposed_fixture.window: Hann support1000–1200s; sqrt(window) passed to linear P map so squared energy has one Hann factor

physical_degree_scale_only.caveat: Dimensional scale, not a converged Lmax or a fixed pass criterion.

required_before_physical_timings: Verify baseline receiver trace contains intended signal in1000–1200s window.
Build q from baseline energy derivative; freeze q only for analytic kernel linearization. Separate returned linear q-dot-Pu (twice baseline energy) from energy itself.
Apply frequency-band weights and time-window processing in the specified order and use the exact reverse adjoint; windowing mixes frequency samples.
Handle DC explicitly: FreqFull default i1 starts at1, while high-level evaluate permits firstBin0. Do not silently labelDC-excluded calculation as includingDC.
Gate receiver waveform and windowed energy against degree/radial/time-padding convergence before kernel performance claims.
Gate kernel output at adequate L, using native grid for complete2L bandwidth; assess full-sphere/radial output memory before scheduling.
Compare DSpec and YSpec with identical model, physical source, receiver component, frequency grid/damping/filter, window and baseline energy derivative.
old_benchmark_limits: Earlier48-bin case spans through18.75mHz on its fixed grid.
The old128-sample/20s fixed-weight fixture is a performance/equivalence control, not the requestedphysicalenergycase.
No backend timing superiority is inferred for Eigen versus BLAS without identical-layout comparisons.

receiver_selection.legacy_window_issue: S arrives at the trailing zero of the1000–1200s Hann window.
receiver_selection.caveat: ObsPy TauP PREM ray arrivals only; finite-band baseline waveform still must be computed/checked.

source_status: No converged PREM DSpec/YSpec kernel or physical runtime comparison has been run in this checking phase.
